title: The N+1 Query Problem: How to Stop Killing Your Database

scenes.narration: Why is your backend API crawling at a snail's pace? You probably have the dreaded N plus 1 query problem.

props.title: The N+1 Query Problem
props.subtitle: How one innocent loop silently destroys your database performance

scenes.narration: You write a loop to fetch users and their posts. Behind your back, the ORM runs an extra query for every single user. One query silently explodes into hundreds.

props.title: THE N+1 EXPLOSION
props.bottomSubtext: Network roundtrips choke your database connection pool.

scenes.narration: The fix is eager loading. Using select related or prefetch tells the database to fetch relational data in bulk, replacing a hundred roundtrips with a single fast join.

props.code:
# ❌ BAD: Triggers N+1 Queries
users = User.query.all()
for user in users:
    print(user.profile.bio)

# ✅ FAST: Eager Loading with JOIN
users = User.query.options(
    joinedload(User.profile)
).all()

lineNotes.note: Spams a query per loop iteration
Eager loads profile in 1 single JOIN query

scenes.narration: With eager loading and composite indexing, query execution drops from nearly a full second down to twelve milliseconds. Always check your execution plan.
